integrity: Two self-contained independent programs validate graph construction, MMD classification, minimum size and all 125 strong metric bases; package byte counts and SHA-256 are independently computed on decoded content.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for GP(25,2); small finite-search steps certified by included complete enumerators. No conjecture for other orders or independently established historical priority.
title: A sharp counterexample and all strong metric bases of \(GP(25,2)\)
